In `ExistingMacIT.java`, the explicit setting of the native map property to `"false"` reinforces this default behavior for that specific integration test, ensuring that it does not fail due to the absence of the native library. Together, these modifications aim to stabilize the testing environment by preventing potential failures related to native map configurations.
